description: Offline vetoes of frozen accepted non-self substitutions; FONT-01 train is calibration, validation/test held-out development, P2 spent development. Net retirement cannot be inferred from occurrence vetoes.

method.runs: word=(page,span_id); lines=greedy page-local y-overlap/baseline; financial occurrence IDs resolved with (page,id)
method.normalization: train-only per-character per-DPI medians, residual median per run
method.noise: train-only oracle-pure same-face run pairs; length scale sqrt(1/n1+1/n2)
method.cluster: per-page deterministic single-linkage under same feature thresholds; missing runs abstain
method.C1: same OCR label plus dimensionless structural check: dot equality, flag difference <=0.20, foot <=0.25; round hole presence threshold 0.015; missing masks abstain
method.C2: exclude sharing when either OCR label is confusable
method.fallback: S1b k veto only if either run has fewer than 3 normalizable glyphs
method.net_retirement: unavailable: occurrence decisions do not identify which original outlines remain live or added canonicals disappear
